bullets.text: Zero-Waste Connectivity Solution - **RETN** launches Flex IX, combining Remote IX access and IP Transit to eliminate unused bandwidth.
5G Spectrum Boost - **UK** telcos secure 5.4 GHz mmWave spectrum for enhanced 5G capacity in crowded areas.
Energy Efficiency Research - New findings highlight the urgent need for energy-saving strategies in **5G** networks.
PSTN Switch-Off Deadline - **Openreach** warns businesses to prepare for the PSTN switch-off by December 2025.
Black Sea Cable Project - **Vodafone** plans a €116 million submarine cable to enhance connectivity in the Black Sea region.
GSMA's New Entitlements Service - Aims to streamline collaboration between mobile operators and device manufacturers.
AI Regulations Challenge - Telecoms face a complex web of global regulations impacting AI deployment and compliance.
Data Centre Expansion Delays - Lack of fibre connectivity is hindering the growth of **UK** data centres, according to a new study.
Connectivity, Your Way - **LightSpeed Networks** challenges commoditisation with bespoke connectivity solutions for partners.
Netomnia's Ambitious Goals - **Netomnia** aims to become the largest altnet in the **UK**, targeting 5 million premises by 2027.
